title: Skala ReSharper export bridge
description: The one place in the option registry that names another tool's keys: for each Skala option, the spelling(s) the Rider export writes for it. Provenance, never ingestion — nothing here is indexed by `OptionRegistry.TryResolve`, so a `resharper_*` key in a user's .editorconfig is an unknown key (SK9001). Split out of options.json so that file names no other tool; the data cannot be deleted, because `jb cleanupcode` understands this namespace and no other, and `CanonicalEditorConfig.Compose` translates the export through it. docs/plan/03-configuration-model.md § "The option registry".

unmapped.description: Foreign keys that options.json's measurements refer to but that Skala carries no option for, each with what it is and where it was measured. They live here so a negative control stays reproducible without options.json holding another tool's spelling. Read by nothing at build time; the generator ignores this member.

spellings.description: Skala option key -> the export's spelling(s) for it. Every option in options.json has an entry and every entry names an option that exists; the generator fails the build (SKG006, SKG007) if either stops being true. ⚠ The mapping is recorded rather than computed: `skala_x` is `resharper_x` for some keys and `resharper_csharp_x` for others, and most keys carry both plus unprefixed forms.

additionalProperties.description: Significance order, most specific first, and load-bearing twice: `CanonicalEditorConfig.Translate` reads the index as the specificity rank where the export sets one option under two spellings in one section, and `ExportSpellings.ForOracle` hands element 0 to the oracle.
